request.questionText: Consider the "Import Dataset" window in RStudio, shown below. We've highlighted four parts of this window with numbered boxes. To what does each of these boxes refer?

blanks.label: The raw .csv file. It’s what you’d see if you opened the file in a plain text editor.
The name of the object in R that will be created; how you’ll refer to the data set.
This tells R whether the first row contains the names of the variables.
How the imported data set will appear to R, with any header row shown in bold.
